structured.answer: I didn't decide anything. The page lists the kinds of saving, and the safe ones I recognise are deposits, savings plans and government bonds. I'll ask my son or the bank about government bonds and that "מק"מ" thing. Nothing on the page told me what pays more than my deposit or what the bank charges me.

stuck.where: "מאיפה להתחיל" section on the first screen
stuck.why: It sends me to קרן השתלמות, קרן חדשה מקיפה and קרן כספית. None of them is for a retiree who has deposits, and I don't know קרן כספית.

stuck.where: "במה הכסף מושקע" on the second screen
stuck.why: Box after box of מדד with English letters (S&P 500, MSCI). It felt like the stock market, so I stopped reading that part.
I don't know who 'מקור' is or whether to trust it. It isn't a bank.

"כסף שוטף וקצר" cards: פיקדון, תכנית חיסכון, חשבון עובר ושב

findings.what: Light grey text on a black background, and the small descriptions inside the boxes are hard to read even enlarged
No numbers at all, so I can't tell whether anything pays more than my deposit or what the fees are
"מאיפה להתחיל" only speaks to salaried employees and suggests a קרן כספית without explaining it
Half the page is stock indices with English letters, which scared me off
Unknown site, "אתר אישי", with no name I know
Words like מק"מ and קופון are used without a simple explanation
